rows.question: How is OEE calculated?
rows.answer: OEE: Overall equipment effectiveness = availability × performance × quality, computed as good output ÷ ideal output for the planned time. Aggregated from totals — never by averaging line OEEs, which would overweight small lines. It is calculated as sum(good kg) / sum(ideal output kg) and owned by Manufacturing Excellence. From the glossary: OEE combines availability (share of planned time the line ran), performance (speed versus the ideal rate) and quality (share of good output) [N1].

rows.question: What does OTIF mean?
rows.answer: Supplier OTIF: Share of deliveries that arrived on or before the promised date and with at least 98% of the ordered quantity. It is calculated as share of deliveries that were on time and in full and owned by Procurement. From the glossary: A delivery is OTIF when it arrives on or before the promised date and contains at least 98% of the ordered quantity [N1].
